editionLabel: Greater Than Games English core rulebook, 2016–2018
firstPlayerRule: Spirit Island has no first player. It is cooperative, and all players act simultaneously within each phase of every turn.
clarifications: Each turn runs Spirit Phase, Fast Power Phase, Invader Phase, Slow Power Phase and Time Passes; players confer freely.
When timing matters, players resolve Powers in whatever order they want, as long as no Power interrupts another partway through.
If a group decision cannot be agreed and it does not come from a Power or a land, the game owner or organizer makes the call.
